# Conditional outcomes

There are several possible outcomes. If the café cache matches, return the result. If the cache misses, run the operation. <!-- want "filler.document-justification" -->

There are exactly two outcomes. If the cache matches, return the result. If the cache misses, run the operation.

There are several possible outcomes for remote clients. If the cache matches, return the result. If the cache misses, run the operation.

There are several possible outcomes. If the cache entries, return the result. If the server responses, run the operation.
